title: THE RECKONING ENGINE
subtitle: A MACHINE FOR THOSE WHO STILL FEEL SOMETHING.
intro: Part cathedral. Part prison. Part salvation. The Black Well consumes, refines, and reveals. Each chamber holds a story. Each descent, a choice.
returnVisitLines: NOTHING DESCENDS TWICE THE SAME WAY.
WHAT WAS SEEN ONCE IS OWED A SECOND LOOK.
THE THIRD DESCENT IS NEVER AN ACCIDENT.
THOSE WHO COUNT THE LANTERNS ARE COUNTED IN TURN.
THREE MARKS HIDE WHERE THE LIGHT DOES NOT REACH.
afterMidnightLines: THE DEAD HOURS KEEP THEIR OWN LEDGER.
AFTER MIDNIGHT THE WELL STOPS PRETENDING TO SLEEP.
WHAT IS AWAKE NOW WAS NEVER MEANT TO REST.
soldOutLine: SEALED. THE WELL KEEPS WHAT IT TAKES.
lockedLine: THE ASCENT IS NOT OFFERED. IT IS FOUND.
dormantLine: THIS CHAMBER HAS NOT YET WOKEN.
countdownLine: THE CHAMBER OPENS WHEN THE COUNT ENDS.
unlockLine: THE SEAL BREAKS FOR THOSE WHO LOOKED.
thanksLine: THE WELL KEEPS WHAT IT IS GIVEN.
nothingLive: NOTHING IS OFFERED. THE WELL WAITS.
